findings.evidence: FR-010, contract Isolation rule 4, SC-004: src/Iskender.Infrastructure.PostgreSql/VersionedRows.cs UpdateAsync/DeleteAsync run WHERE id = $1 AND row_version = $2 and NoRowChangedAsync runs SELECT 1 ... WHERE id = $1, with no owner predicate, so versioned writes rely on row-level security alone; CrossScopeTests covers no versioned operation in either predicate mode. Gap type contradicts. T047.

FR-025, TR-11, contract Health rule 3: src/Iskender.Infrastructure.PostgreSql/Health/PostgreSqlHealthProbe.cs ReadAsync reads the HistoryExistsSql result (to_regclass(isk_migrations.history)) outside its try. On the pinned postgres 17 image, a login without USAGE on isk_migrations (not a member of iskender_runtime) gets ERROR permission denied for schema isk_migrations (42501) from to_regclass, so AttemptAsync classifies it Unexpected and the probe reports unexpected, not insufficient_privilege. Gap type partial. T048.

Contract Diagnostics event 4007 (The runner holds the lock and starts): src/Iskender.Infrastructure.PostgreSql/Migrations/PostgreSqlMigrationRunner.cs RunAsync logs MigrationStarted before opening the connection or taking the lock, so a run that ends persistence.migration_locked still logs 4007. Gap type contradicts. T049.
